question: Which of the following is a fair held at the shrine of Mastan Shah Vali?
solution:
The correct answer is **Dhamoni Urs.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dhamoni Urs** is a fair held at the shrine of Mastan Shah Vali.
 
• It is organized in Madhya Pradesh's **Sagar **district located in **Dhamoni**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• This fair is held in April-May.
 
• '**Dhamoni**' is about 50 km north of the Sagar district on Jhansi road. 
 
• Another notable place here is two mausoleums of Muslim saints.
 
• One of them is the tomb of **Baljit Shah**, who is considered the mentor of the famous Mughal period historian Abul Fazl.
 
• The second tomb is considered to be** **of **'Mastan Shah Wali'.**
